ops.title: Graphite merge queue replays graphite-base/N..head onto trunk; a submit that moves graphite-base/N mid-restack drops commits
ops.body:
Evidence: Forge-AI/monorepo 2026-10-06. #31034 (iris-memory-04-sessions) landed 16:49:46Z; graphite-app moved its children #31036 and #31041 to base graphite-base/<n> at 16:49:37-39Z. At 16:50:41Z lane mem-05 ran `ccx vcs ship --tip-only --no-commit` after `gt track --parent iris-memory-04-sessions-membership`; ship pushed #31036's head on membership AND (per #154's gtParkedBases) pushed graphite-base/31036 to membership's head 478196b. At 16:50:49Z graphite-app force-pushed #31036 to 80a7a3e: six commits straight on dev's squash b97522f, membership's commit gone. That is exactly graphite-base/31036..head replayed onto trunk. Then "cursor" (Graphite app) set the base to dev at 16:51:19Z.

Conclusion: no `ccx vcs stack submit` re-parented anything; the drop is Graphite's queue restack racing a ccx push that moved graphite-base/N. #154's push is right for a pre-submit park (parent not landed) and wrong for a queue park (parent landed).

Fix (PR yasyf/cc-context#289): gtRefuseQueueRestack refuses a submit when a planned PR is parked on graphite-base/N, Graphite's newest version names a non-trunk parent, and pruneLanded says that parent landed, unless the submit targets trunk. Test: TestShipLeavesAPullRequestTheQueueIsRestackingAlone.
